question: Will Flávio Bolsonaro finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
resolution_criteria:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate who receives the second-most valid votes in the first round of this election.

The named candidates will be primarily ranked by the number of valid votes received in the specified election. If two or more candidates are tied on valid votes, ties will be broken by alphabetical order of the candidates' last names. This market will resolve to the candidate that occupies the second-highest finishing position after applying this ranking.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).
research:
I couldn't find any poll from before the cutoff showing a candidate other than Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro within about 20 points of second place. The main way Flávio misses second is by beating Lula and finishing first. Polls up to the cutoff had Lula ahead by about 6 to 10 points. Three page fetches (the TSE source, a full Wikipedia polling table and an Orrery market page) were refused by the proxy, so most of what follows comes from search summaries of the articles. I left out everything dated after 2026-09-22, including a Datafolha poll released on 23 September.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding source is the Superior Electoral Court's (TSE) official first-round count, ranked by valid votes, with credible reporting as the first check. The first round is scheduled for 2026-10-04.
- I could not get a live reading or date from the TSE page because the fetch was refused. As of the 2026-09-22 cutoff, no results existed.
- Flávio finishes second only if Lula beats him and no third candidate passes him.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settled the question before the cutoff.
- Every major pollster's most recent national poll before the cutoff had Flávio second behind Lula. In those polls the third-place candidate was 20 or more points below him.
- One outlier (Veritá, published 2026-04, fieldwork 13 March to 4 April) had Flávio first with 35.9% to Lula's 33.2%. [CNN Brasil](https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/eleicoes/verita-flavio-tem-359-e-lula-332-no-1o-turno/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-10: PoderData had Augusto Cury (Avante) at 10%, Renan Santos (Missão) at 3%, Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) at 2% and Romeu Zema (Novo) at 1%. It was the first time Cury reached double digits with that pollster. [Gazeta do Povo](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral-2026/augusto-cury-primeiro-candidato-que-ultrapassou-10-intencoes-de-voto-alem-de-flavio-lula/)
- 2026-09-14: This was the TSE deadline to approve or block presidential candidacies. Renan Santos's candidacy was the subject of a suspension controversy. [Gazeta do Povo](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/ascensao-de-cury-e-posicao-antissistema-de-renan-santos-isolam-ex-governadores/)
- 2026-09-03: Datafolha (fieldwork 1 to 3 September, 2,002 interviews, ±2 points): first round Lula 38%, Flávio 32%; second round Lula 46%, Flávio 44%. [Gazeta do Povo](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral-2026/datafolha-presidente-setembro-2026/)
- About 2026-09-02: Quaest had Lula 37%, Flávio 30% and Cury 10% in the first round, with a 42% to 41% tie in the second round. [Gazeta do Povo](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral-2026/quaest-presidente-setembro-2026/)
- 2026-08-31: Nexus/BTG had Lula 37%, Flávio 31% and Cury 11%. [Gazeta do Povo](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral-2026/pesquisas-que-confirmam-avanco-augusto-cury/)
- Late August (fieldwork 25 to 30 August): AtlasIntel had Lula 43.4% and Flávio 33.7% in the first round, with Cury around 7.8% and Renan Santos around 7.6%. [Gazeta do Povo](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral-2026/atlasintel-presidente-agosto-2026/)
- About 2026-06-08: Quaest had Lula 39% and Flávio 29%. The Perseu Abramo Foundation (linked to Lula's party, the PT) blamed Flávio's drop on leaked audio recordings. [FPA](https://fpabramo.org.br/lula-flavio-bolsonaro-primeiro-turno-pesquisa-quaest/)
- 2026-03: Datafolha had a second-round tie, Lula 46% and Flávio 43%. Ratinho Júnior dropped out on 23 March. [Yahoo/Reuters](https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/flavio-bolsonaro-draws-even-lula-161733328.html), [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Social_Democratic_Party_presidential_selection)

## 4. Base rates
- In Brazil's two-round elections from 1989 to 2022, the two leaders in the final polls have almost always been the top two in the first round. The order has usually matched the polls, though 2022 is an exception to watch: Lula led by about 14 points in Datafolha's final poll but won by about 5. That was from my own background knowledge; I did not verify it with a search here.
- Polls before the cutoff consistently put Lula ahead of Flávio in the first round, from about 6 points (Datafolha, early September) to about 10 points (AtlasIntel, late August). The gap was 9 to 13 points in January and 10 points in June, so it narrowed over the year.
- The closest third-place candidate was Cury at 7.8% to 11%, about 20 points behind Flávio.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-04-02: Lines.com reported Polymarket's "YES" price for Flávio in second at about 60%, but its headline cited 72%, so the source contradicts itself. [Lines](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/elections/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-2nd-place)
- About 2026-04-30: Kalshi priced Lula for second at about 26¢, against about 19¢ on Polymarket. [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/api/public/market/KXBRPRESIDENT2-BRPRES26-2-LSIL)
- 2026-05-18: Orrery showed Polymarket at about 62% for Flávio in second. [Orrery](https://www.orrery.me/markets/will-flvio-bolsonaro-finish-in-second-place-in-the-first-round-of-the-2026-brazilian-presidential-election)
- Undated: Polyguana showed Zema's second-place contract at about 96¢ "No", and Caiado's and Geraldo Alckmin's also strongly "No". [Polyguana](https://polyguana.com/es/events/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-2nd-place)
- I could not find a Polymarket or Kalshi price from September 2026.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- More Datafolha, Quaest and AtlasIntel polls before 4 October, including the final ones.
- TV debates in the last weeks of the campaign.
- Possible tactical voting on the right moving Cury's or Renan Santos's supporters to Flávio, which could narrow or reverse the gap with Lula.
- The vote itself on 2026-10-04, with TSE results expected that night.
